question: Where do reproducible extensions' results live in the output base, in what format, and do they name the selected Go module version; what do gazelle facts record for a replaced module?

verdict.hidden_lockfile: CONFIRMED on 8.8.2 and 9.3.2 (<output_base>/MODULE.bazel.lock, the workspace lock's own JSON format, names the selected version of every go_deps repository); absent on 7.7.2, where nothing in the output base names the version
verdict.facts_as_selection_proof: REFUTED: required_mod_files_v1 lists the .mod files `go list` was fed, not the selected versions; it names the Socket module at the pin while Bazel builds an unpatched higher version (state skew) and after the replace is gone (state restored)

fixture.root: example.com/x3 requires github.com/jackc/pgx/v5 v5.7.0 and github.com/google/go-cmp v0.5.9
fixture.othermod: a second Bazel module (local_path_override) whose go.mod requires pgx v5.7.1
